title: AnomalyBench: a reproducible benchmarking suite for anomaly detection algorithms
description:
AnomalyBench is a Python research package that bundles anomaly detection algorithms, benchmark dataset loaders, and a command line interface for comparing detectors on standard datasets under a single reproducible protocol.

Contents

  • Detectors. More than thirty implementations and adapters spanning classical statistical and distance methods (Isolation Forest, k-Nearest Neighbors, Histogram-Based Outlier Score, One-Class SVM, DBSCAN, Elliptic Envelope, Gaussian Mixture, Local Outlier Factor, KMeans, PCA reconstruction, Mahalanobis distance, Kernel Density, Stochastic Outlier Selection), ensemble and probabilistic methods (COPOD, ECOD, Feature Bagging, LODA, ABOD), deep methods (Autoencoder, Denoising Autoencoder, Variational Autoencoder, LSTM Autoencoder, Transformer, AnoGAN, MAD-GAN), streaming methods (Half-Space Trees, Online Isolation Forest), graph methods (Degree Centrality, Graph Isolation Forest), forecasting methods (ARIMA, Prophet), and modern tabular methods (Random Feature Isolation Forest, Random Network Distillation).
  • Datasets. Loaders for tabular, image, time-series, and graph benchmarks, with a metadata catalogue recording source URLs, license notes, modality, task type, label semantics, and file integrity hashes.
  • Evaluation. ROC AUC, average precision, precision@k, recall@k, F1 at threshold, best F1, and runtime, reported alongside each detector's score orientation so methods with different score semantics can be compared explicitly.
  • Reproducibility. Every run emits a manifest capturing the package version, Python version, dataset keys, detector keys and parameters, random seed, metric configuration, configuration hash, timestamp, and dataset integrity hashes. Results append to a structured CSV leaderboard.
  • Extensibility. A uniform fit / score / detect_anomalies detector lifecycle and a plugin registry that lets external packages contribute detectors without forking the project.

Usage

Install from PyPI and run the bundled command line interface:

pip install anomalybench
benchmark-cli --config anomalybench/benchmarks/benchmark_config.yml

Optional extras enable the deep learning (anomalybench[deep]), streaming (anomalybench[streaming]), and forecasting (anomalybench[forecasting]) detector stacks. The project targets Python 3.12.
